title: Allpole Filter
text: Model allpole filters, 2 inputs, 1 output, no direct feedthrough, {Integer rounding mode} sets Integer rounding mode; {Coefficient source}, {Filter structure}, {Coefficients} sets the filter denominator coefficients, {Input processing}, {Initial states} sets the initial conditions of filter states, {Coefficients Minimum} sets the minimum value of filter coefficients, {Coefficients Maximum} sets the maximum value of filter coefficients, {Product output}, {Accumulator}, {State}, {Output}, {Output Minimum}, {Output Maximum}, {Lock data type settings against changes by the fixed-point tools} prevents fixed-point tools from overriding data and {Saturate on integer overflow}. Values come from the instance.
